## Description

Employs continuous normalizing flows and generative flow matching to synthesize multi-asset return scenarios governed by vector fields, optimizing portfolio weights under distributional shift.

## Where it may fit

Multi-asset allocation under severe macroeconomic structural breaks and non-Gaussian joint return regimes.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Risk Management Groups, Multi-Asset Allocation Desks.

## Required data

Multivariate historical return series, macroeconomic indicator time series, volatility surfaces.

## Caveats

Ordinary differential equation (ODE) numerical integration during sampling increases computational inference time.
